description: Election Commission - Filling of Vacancy of the Members of the Dimbulagala, Minuwangoda and Mahara Pradeshiya Sabhas
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to members not attending meetings or ceasing party membership. It involves electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including declarations of elected members to fill these vacancies. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically addressing vacancies in elected offices and the procedures for filling them.
